function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies caller identity against the account record using the last 4 digits of PAN or year of birth. Must be called before any debt/EMI/overdue information is disclosed. Returns verified=false on mismatch — do not disclose debt in that case.

account_id.description: Account ID for the target customer, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The 4-digit PAN suffix or 4-digit birth year the caller provided

function.name: get_account_details
function.description: Fetches the current overdue amount, days-past-due, and loan type for a verified account. Only call after verify_customer has returned verified=true.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs a promise-to-pay commitment once the customer has agreed to a specific date and amount.

ptp_date.description: ISO-8601 date the customer committed to pay, e.g. 2026-08-21

amount.description: Amount the customer committed to pay

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Sends a payment link to the customer's registered mobile number via SMS and/or WhatsApp. Call this right after log_promise_to_pay succeeds.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Hands the call off to a human collections agent for cases the bot should not resolve on its own: disputes, hardship requiring authorized restructuring, or a caller requesting a human.

notes.description: One or two lines of context for the human agent

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final outcome of the call. Must be called exactly once, at the end of every call, regardless of how the call ended.
